dict.string: OmniDesk uses the microphone for local, on-device wake-word detection ("Dhuli") and voice commands. Audio is processed strictly in memory and is never transmitted off your device.
OmniDesk uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice commands locally on your Mac.
OmniDesk needs full calendar access to query your schedule, detect meeting conflicts, and organize events.
This app needs calendar access to create events and check schedule availability.
OmniDesk needs reminders access to track tasks, to-dos, and follow-ups.
OmniDesk needs reminders access to track tasks and follow-ups.
OmniDesk needs permission to communicate with Apple Mail to search communications, prepare drafts, and manage messages.
